comment: UI performance and memory budgets (docs/architecture/ui-style-and-feedback-spec.md sections 4.10, 11; ui-and-controls-spec.md section 9; m3-build-spec.md section 8). Read by tools/ui/perf_ui.gd. Never read by a GUT test.

screen_push_cpu_worst_ms.what: worst cold instantiate + ScreenStack.push time across M1.5 screens

screen_push_worst_ms.what: worst first-frame push + render time across M1.5 screens

hud_frame_worst_ms.what: worst frame with HUD + HexPanel open at 1920x1080

minimap_frame_worst_ms.what: worst frame with the HUD and the minimap in a country game (Genoa) at 1920x1080 (M2)

pick_frame_worst_ms.what: worst frame with the country pick open at 1920x1080 (M2)

report_push_ms.what: the season report's first-frame push + render with the nine-section fixture at 1920x1080 (M3)

save_load_push_ms.what: worst first-frame push + render of Save and Load with 12 saved rows, Save and Load tabs (M3)

log_open_ms.what: opening the action log with two seasons of lines, first drawn frame (M3)

ribbons_16_frame_ms.what: mean CPU time a frame of Floaters.advance with 16 live ribbons (M3)

season_fade_capture_ms.what: the season fade's capture frame on the owner's Mac; enforced with --gpu-limits (M3)

kit_1x_mb.what: 1x Studiolo UI kit RGBA8 memory in play (budget < 4 MB)

kit_2x_mb.what: 2x Studiolo UI kit RGBA8 memory in play (budget < 16 MB)
